race.comment: MISS AUSTRALIANA (3) is an in-form mare on quick back-up after landing a hat trick with a win by close to 4m at Newcastle on Friday. Led from a wider barrier there so should be able to take advantage of the good draw. Up in grade but can continue on her winning way. PRINCESS OF SAVOY NZ (1) is a newcomer to the David Aiken yard having raced twice in Brisbane since switching from NZ. Should enjoy an economical run from the inside draw so could measure up. MILLI ME (4) showed improvement in the last-start fourth and should be nearing peak fitness now so could produce her best today. BLISSES BEST (8) chased a good mare when runner up in the Breeders Challenge 4M Final last start. Draws out but came from this barrier to win at this circuit and distance last month and has been consistent since.
